description: This file declares functions related to configuration management and environment variable handling within the TRACE2 framework, providing an interface for listing and setting config parameters, as well as freeing related resources.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_list_config_fl
methods.description: Iterates over all configuration settings and emits 'def_param' events for interesting ones to TRACE2.

methods.name: tr2_list_env_vars_fl
methods.description: Iterates over environment variables and emits 'def_param' events for those deemed interesting.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_set_fl
methods.description: Emits a 'def_param' event for a specific key/value pair if the key is considered interesting.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_free_patterns
methods.description: Frees memory associated with configuration pattern resources.

methods.name: tr2_cfg_free_env_vars
methods.description: Frees memory associated with environment variables list.
